lines.en: Step. Click. Step. Click.
My joints creak. That's normal.
Slow down. Copper wears thin.
My left foot's a bit heavier.

lines.zh: 铜块上生出的我，走得稳。
lines.en: Born on a copper block. My steps are steady.

lines.zh: 我沿墙根走，那里没人挡。
lines.en: Walking by the wall. No one blocks me.
Patina flakes on the path. I ignore it.

lines.zh: 前方三步有台阶，我算过了。
lines.en: Stairs in three steps. I counted.
My shadow has corners.
Don't rush me. Gears turn this fast.

lines.zh: 巡逻一圈，箱子都锁好了。
lines.en: One patrol. All chests are shut.
Uneven ground. Adjusting my balance.
I pass and the grass doesn't bend.
Walk long enough and the knees stiffen.
Idle. My eyes still glow.
Standing by the chest, waiting for work.

lines.zh: 锈又深了一层，我数着呢。
lines.en: Another shade of patina. I'm counting.
Wind on my copper skin. Cool.

lines.zh: 咔嗒。没什么事，我清清嗓子。
lines.en: Click. Nothing wrong. Clearing my throat.
Thinking about that copper button.

lines.zh: 有只蜘蛛在箱子上爬，我盯着。
lines.en: A spider's on the chest. I'm watching it.
Fingers stiff. Flexing them.
So much dust in this room.

lines.zh: 我在算东西该放哪一格。
lines.en: Working out which slot things belong in.
No need to move. Saving copper.

lines.zh: 有人叫我的名字吗？没有。
lines.en: Did someone call me? No.

lines.zh: 我的胸口有块绿斑，很难看。
lines.en: There's a green spot on my chest. Ugly.
Standing here is also work.
Your hands smell of copper.

lines.zh: 我在看你有没有拿箱子。
lines.en: Checking whether you're carrying a chest.

lines.zh: 你比我高两格半，我量过。
lines.en: You're two and a half blocks up. I measured.
You blink. I don't.

lines.zh: 你刚才碰了铜块，我听见了。
lines.en: You touched a copper block. I heard it.
What am I carrying? Be specific.
Looking up at you. My neck clicks.
That axe. Put it away.
You smile. Copper doesn't.

lines.zh: 你身上有铁的味道，不是铜。
lines.en: You smell of iron, not copper.
I remember your footsteps.

lines.zh: 你站在我巡过的路线上。
lines.en: You're standing on my patrol route.
Dented, but still functional.
My copper skin is scratched open.
Doesn't hurt. Still, I'm not pleased.
A patch of patina fell off.
Joint out of line. Putting it back.
Who did that? Name yourself.
A dent in my copper hide, and I keep the receipt.
My eyes flickered twice.
Copper bends. It doesn't beg.
Patch me up and I'll keep working.
Food? I don't eat.
Waving wheat at me won't work.
Chests and buttons. That's all I answer to.
There's no stomach inside me.

lines.zh: 别用胡萝卜引诱我，我不是猪。
lines.en: Don't dangle carrots. I'm not a pig.
Patina is my only food.

lines.zh: 你把东西放下，我就处理。
lines.en: Set it down and I'll deal with it.

lines.zh: 诱惑对我无效，我是金属。
lines.en: Temptation doesn't work. I'm metal.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，请放进铜箱。
lines.en: Whatever you're holding, put it in the copper chest.

lines.zh: 我对甜菜没兴趣，对分类有兴趣。
lines.en: No interest in beets. Plenty in sorting.
You hit me. I shifted half a block.
Lighter than stone. Not by much.

lines.zh: 你膝盖没事吧？我这边没事。
lines.en: Is your knee all right? I'm fine.
That spun me around.
Step aside, I'm carrying goods.
There's a new dent in my copper.
Off balance. Steadying on the wall.

lines.zh: 铜关节咔一声，我自己转。
lines.en: My copper joints click; I turn on my own.

lines.zh: 这一撞，我的锈掉了一层。
lines.en: That knock shook off a layer of patina.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，谁也没让。
lines.en: We collided. Neither of us yielded.
A mate? I was placed here.

lines.zh: 铜块加南瓜，就是我的来历。
lines.en: Copper block plus pumpkin. That's my origin.
No kin. Only copies.

lines.zh: 你要再造一个？记得用雕刻南瓜。
lines.en: Making another? Use a carved pumpkin.
We don't produce little golems.

lines.zh: 我的寿命是氧化，不是繁衍。
lines.en: My lifespan is oxidation, not offspring.

lines.zh: 别靠这么近，我身上有绿锈。
lines.en: Not so close, I'm green with patina.

lines.zh: 同类见面，互相对一下按钮就好。
lines.en: When golems meet, we click buttons at each other.

lines.zh: 这事不在我的工作范围里。
lines.en: That's outside my job description.
I sort. I don't do anything else.

lines.zh: 捡起来，归到该去的格子。
lines.en: Picked up. Filing it where it belongs.
Ore. This goes on the left.
I can only hold one thing.
Don't pile more on me.
This one goes to the trapped chest.

lines.zh: 铜箱子里的东西，我一件件分。
lines.en: From the copper chest, one item at a time.
Weight noted. Thirty-two of them.
I can carry it. Can't walk fast with it.

lines.zh: 这玩意儿卡住我手指了。
lines.en: This thing's stuck in my fingers.
Set down. Next item.

lines.zh: 铜箱里有东西动了，我过去。
lines.en: Something moved in the copper chest. On my way.
That pile needs sorting.
Unsorted items detected in the pile.
That chest lid is open.
Something rolled onto the floor.
Target locked. That heap of junk.

lines.zh: 铜按钮在墙那边，我看见了。
lines.en: The copper button's across the wall. I see it.
Arrows go here, not bread.

lines.zh: 有人乱塞东西，我得重整。
lines.en: Someone stuffed things wrong. I'll fix it.

lines.zh: 目标：那只开着的陷阱箱。
lines.en: Target: that open trapped chest.
Everything on the floor gets collected.
This takes two trips.
It's blocking my route.

lines.zh: 这台机器又卡住了，我去看看。
lines.en: That machine jammed again. I'll check.

lines.zh: 我在算你到箱子的距离。
lines.en: Calculating your distance to the chest.

lines.zh: 别动，我正对着那堆东西。
lines.en: Hold still, I'm aimed at that pile.

lines.zh: 路径规划完成，直走六格。
lines.en: Path set. Six blocks straight.

lines.zh: 我盯着它，直到它被收好。
lines.en: Watching it until it's put away.
That item in your hand. Hand it over.
Priority: trapped chest first.

lines.zh: 我眼睛的红光落到它上面了。
lines.en: My red glow just landed on it.
Three seconds, then I move.

lines.zh: 别挡在中间，我要走过去。
lines.en: Don't stand in the way. I'm walking there.
Locked on. I won't lose it.

lines.zh: 这只箱子被塞满了，我盯着它。
lines.en: That chest is overstuffed. I'm on it.
My hand is already reaching.
Target moving. I'm recalculating.
It wants to run. Copper hands don't loosen.
One punch, and it's copper.
A shove. Move aside.
Not a fighter. But I can knock.

lines.zh: 这一下按在你肩上，像按按钮。
lines.en: That landed on your shoulder, like a button.
My fist is heavy. Don't block it.

lines.zh: 你碰坏了箱子，我回敬一下。
lines.en: You broke the chest. I return the favour.
Joint jammed. Trying again.
Copper doesn't tire. It dulls.
Leave. This area is mine to keep.
Missed. Adjusting my angle.
You backed off two blocks. Far enough.

lines.zh: 我把你当成要搬的东西。
lines.en: I'm treating you like cargo.
Don't make me knock again.

lines.zh: 我的手掌印留在你衣服上。
lines.en: My handprint's on your clothes now.

lines.zh: 南瓜扣在铜块上，我醒了。
lines.en: Pumpkin on copper. I wake.

lines.zh: 氧化程度和这块铜一样。
lines.en: My patina matches this block exactly.

lines.zh: 我从铜里站起来，关节咔咔响。
lines.en: Rising out of copper, joints cracking.

lines.zh: 新傀儡报到，可以派活了。
lines.en: New golem reporting. Assign me work.

lines.zh: 我第一眼看见的是南瓜灯。
lines.en: The first thing I saw was a jack o'lantern.

lines.zh: 铜块还热着，我踩上去刚好。
lines.en: The copper's still warm. Good footing.

lines.zh: 我身上带着铜绿，天生的。
lines.en: Born with patina. It's natural.

lines.zh: 谁摆的南瓜？我记住位置了。
lines.en: Who placed that pumpkin? I noted the spot.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛亮了，说明我上岗了。
lines.en: Eyes lit. That means I'm on duty.

lines.zh: 这地方箱子不少，正缺人手。
lines.en: Plenty of chests here. Short on hands.

lines.zh: 我刚被拼好，让我站一站。
lines.en: Just assembled. Let me stand a moment.

lines.zh: 我闻到了铜箱子的味道。
lines.en: I smell a copper chest.

lines.zh: 出生点就在铜块上，很合理。
lines.en: Spawned on a copper block. Makes sense.
Find the pumpkin, then find the work.
The copper's heating. I'm going soft.

lines.zh: 摔下来，膝盖陷进去一点。
lines.en: Fell. Knees sank in a little.

lines.zh: 水灌进缝里，我动作慢了。
lines.en: Water in my seams. Moving slower.
The blast knocked me flat.
An arrow's stuck in my shoulder.

lines.zh: 有什么东西绕过铜皮，直接进来了。
lines.en: Something got past the copper and went in.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，但我会耗尽。
lines.en: I don't eat. I do wear out.

lines.zh: 雷打中我，整块铜都在响。
lines.en: Lightning struck. Every inch of me rings.
Falling. Even copper can fear this.
